## 3. Requirements

### REQ-SW-KEYER-001: Straight key debounce

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Statement | The keyer module shall debounce the straight key input with a 2 ms window and assert PTT within 3 ms. |
| Rationale | Allocated from REQ-SYS-001; 2 ms + 3 ms leaves 0 ms margin to the 5 ms system budget with the hardware filter (ADR-001). |
| Verification method | Test |
| Verification note | Host cargo test with mocked GPIO timeline. |
| Status | Active |
| Parent | REQ-SYS-001 |
| Children | - |
| Sources | ADR-001 |
| Hazards | HZ-001 |
| Design references | firmware/cwht-core/src/keyer/straight.rs |

### REQ-SW-KEYER-003: Keyer speed persistence

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Statement | The keyer module shall restore the last keyer speed from configuration memory within 100 ms of boot. |
| Rationale | Self-derived: ADR-001 records the decision to persist keyer settings so the radio starts with a usable keyer; no parent requirement states it (02 section 2.3). |
